rationale: According to the developer comment, this text is inserted only into mozac_feature_addons_installed_dialog_description_3, where it follows «в» ("in the %1$s"). rationale: The genitive of "буфер" (a technical device) is "буфера". The sibling string mozac_feature_contextmenu_snackbar_link_copied already uses "до буфера", so this one is inconsistent with it.

rationale: The comment says this is the header of a prompt that fills the form with a suggested strong password, so it labels an action. The related strings render the same English as "Використати надійний пароль?" and "Використати пароль". The imperative "Використовуйте" reads as general advice.

rationale: The source and the developer comment describe a device with no camera, so the QR scanner cannot be shown. 'Немає доступу' (no access) reads as a permission problem, which points users toward the wrong cause.
summary: The translation says there is no access to the camera rather than that no camera is available on the device.

current: підсумовувати вміст сторінок, які ви можете контролювати
rationale: The source says the page summaries stay in the user's control. The translation has no noun for "summaries", so "які" can only refer back to "сторінок". It then reads as "pages that you can control", which is a different claim, and the point about privacy is lost.
suggest: створювати підсумки сторінок, які залишаються під вашим контролем
summary: In Ukrainian, the relative clause "які ви можете контролювати" now describes the pages, not the summaries, so the string says the pages are under the user's control.

rationale: TalkBack adds this label after "Double tap to…" (Ukrainian "Двічі торкніться, щоб…"), which needs an infinitive. The sibling labels already use one ("згорнути", "розгорнути"), so the imperative here makes the spoken sentence ungrammatical.
summary: Imperative "відкрийте" is used where TalkBack's appended construction needs an infinitive.

current: Це передбачає можливість використання функцій, вдосконалених ШІ.

summary: "whether to use" AI features is rendered as "the possibility of using" them, losing the sense of choice.

rationale: The same source term "AI enhancements" appears in the toggle title, dialog title, dialog body and banner as "вдосконалення ШІ"; using a different noun in the toggle description on the same screen is inconsistent.

rationale: The source and developer comment describe the overflow menu belonging to a bookmark/folder item; the Ukrainian "Елемент меню" means "a menu item", so screen readers announce the wrong control.

rationale: Every other collection string in this batch uses "Збірки"/"збірку", including the home fragment header (collections_header). Using "Колекції" on the home banner gives users two different words for one feature.

rationale: This error belongs to the "Name on Card" field, which is the cardholder's personal name. "назва" is used for the names of things, and the field header in credit_cards_name_on_card uses "Ім’я".

rationale: The feature provides tools for tabs in general (count, bulk creation); sibling strings use the plural "вкладок" (e.g. "Інструмент створення вкладок"), so the singular genitive is a number error.

current: Завантажте мови для швидшого перекладу офлайн.
rationale: Source lists two benefits: faster translations and the ability to translate offline. The Ukrainian says only 'for faster offline translation', which changes the claim and omits 'complete'.

rationale: The developer comment says %1$s is a localized date such as "Jun 9" that marks when the promotion ends. So "through" here means "until" that date. "протягом" means "during" and needs a span of time, not a date, so "протягом 9 черв." does not say when the promotion ends.
summary: "through %1$s" (until an end date) is rendered as "протягом %1$s" ("during"), which does not fit a single date.

rationale: The subordinate clause introduced by "що" after "знаючи" must be set off with a comma in Ukrainian punctuation.

rationale: This string belongs to the custom app icon prompt, and the icon appears on the phone's home screen. In uk Firefox, "Домівка" is the term for the Firefox Home page, so a user would think the setting changes that page or would read it as their literal home.
summary: "Home screen" is rendered as "домівка", which means a dwelling or, in uk Firefox, the Firefox Home page, not the device home screen.

current: Firefox відомий своєю незалежністю та відданістю

suggest: Firefox гордо зберігає незалежність і відданий
summary: "Is proudly independent" became "is known for its independence", which states Firefox's reputation instead of a plain fact about it.

rationale: The source only promises information about how to stay protected. The Ukrainian promises the user will always be protected.

rationale: In English, "About" works on its own as a menu label. In Ukrainian, "Про" needs an object (for example "Про програму"). On its own it is ungrammatical.

rationale: The en-US sentence ends with a period before </label>. The Ukrainian leaves it out, although the first sentence in the same string keeps its period.
